# A feature branch that merged develop - twice, develop moved in between - and
# then landed on develop by squash or by a merge commit made without sesam
# (GitHub) puts its own entries before develop's. Develop's old log is then no
# prefix of the new one, but the merge entries name develop's tip, which
# accounts for every entry it had.

sesam-repo admin base.txt dev.txt

cp $TMPDIR/base.txt s
exec sesam add s --group admin
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'add s'
exec git branch develop

# feature: own entry.
exec git checkout -b feature
exec sesam tell --user bob --recipient $BOB_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'feature: tell bob'

# develop moves on.
exec git checkout develop
cp $TMPDIR/dev.txt s
exec sesam seal
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'develop: reseal s'

# First update of feature, with sesam's drivers.
exec git checkout feature
! exec git merge --no-edit develop
exec git commit --no-edit
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'

# develop moves on again; second update.
exec git checkout develop
exec sesam tell --user carol --recipient $CAROL_PUBKEY --group dev
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'develop: tell carol'

exec git checkout feature
! exec git merge --no-edit develop
exec git commit --no-edit
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'

# Squash into develop. feature already contains develop, so git takes feature's
# tree without calling any driver - same as GitHub. --no-verify: GitHub runs no hooks.
exec git checkout develop
exec git merge --squash feature
exec git commit --no-verify -m 'squash feature'
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'
exec sesam user ls
stdout bob
stdout carol

# Same with a real merge commit (GitHub "Create a merge commit").
exec git reset --hard HEAD~1
exec git merge --no-ff --no-verify --no-edit feature
exec sesam verify --truncate
stderr 'Audit log history: ok'

-- base.txt --
S=BASE
-- dev.txt --
S=DEV
